newsitem.title: USA: McKesson unit wins $500 million contract.
newsitem.headline: McKesson unit wins $500 million contract.

text.p: McKesson Corp. said Tuesday its Medis Health & Pharmaceutical Services Inc. unit has won a contract valued at $500 million annually to provide health care distribution services to Drug Trading Co. Ltd. of Ontario, Canada.
In a related deal, Medis also agreed to buy the inventory and accounts receivable of Drug Trading's Ontario and Atlantic distribution networks, as well as Drug Trading's Northwest Drug Ltd. unit.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed.
The contract calls for Medis to provide Drug Trading's retail customers with services throughout Canada.
Medis, based in Montreal, is the largest distributor of pharmaceuticals and other pharmacy-related products in Canada with annual revenues of about $1.5 billion.
McKesson, based in San Francisco, is the largest health care supply management company in North America.
McKesson's stock fell $1.25 to $74.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.
